maintenanceReason: The opt-in ranking research harness (priority_ordering_bench --experiment, the ranking_pilot generator, model::pairwise and ExternalScorer::score_directory_bounded) has not earned ongoing maintenance. Two synthetic pilots both returned no-demonstrated-benefit, and no representative corpus, creature or search history was available on any checked host. The predeclared rule in ranking-v1.md tied removal to a representative v2 run. That run has never been possible, so this record departs from the rule. The code was kept for it across two pilots. Replay at the pinned commit keeps the representative comparison runnable without maintaining the code. The removal is a maintenance decision, not evidence that the method fails on representative data.
